integration.purpose: Provide reusable integration assets shared by multiple inventory slices.
integration.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one slice and cross-slice reuse is explicit.

routes.purpose: Expose context-owned route modules consumed by generated deployable adapters.
routes.allowedWhen: Required whenever the context contributes routes to any deployable.
